julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.title: Julier · Albula · Flüela Graubünden Triangle · part 3
julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.slogan: Davos food and weather to Chur

waypoints.name: Davos food and weather check
waypoints.advice: Davos food and weather check is where the day begins. Reckon on about 7 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Landquart return, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Landquart return gate
waypoints.advice: Landquart return comes up 68 km in. You lose 1037 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is back to Chur.

waypoints.name: back to Chur
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 135 km.

sections.advice: Davos food and weather check → Landquart return gate drops about 1037 m over 35 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Landquart return gate → back to Chur is 17 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: 92 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 43 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.story: 135 km one way from Davos - plan on about 2 h 34 of riding. The highest point is 1,560 m.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 31 km this is Basque Coast Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-ekain-eglise-santa-maria-de-la-as.story: From Zestoa it runs 216 km to Zestoa; allow about 3 h 43 of riding. It goes by way of Collégiale de Ziortza, Cathédrale de Saint Jacques Apôtre, Eglise Santa Maria de la Asuncion and back through Cathédrale de Saint Jacques Apôtre. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
